verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents API keys that can expire (Never, One Month, Six Month, or One Year), and you can hold several keys at once for rotation. Every request also carries an organization ID header. None of the evidence shows permission scopes, read-only keys, or least-privilege restrictions on what a key can do, so key expiry and multiple keys are only adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
